title: septic configuration
description: The `septic` block of a poops.json — SQLite schema, REST CRUD, auth and the poops static-site bridge. https://stamat.info/septic

septic.description: Presence is instantiation — nothing mounts unless it is declared.

db.description: SQLite file, resolved relative to this config file.

resources.description: One entry per table, keyed by resource name. The name becomes the table and the `/api/<name>` route.

notify.description: POST a JSON {event, resource, row} to a webhook after a successful HTTP write. Fire-and-forget: a failed notification warns and never fails the write.

url.description: The webhook endpoint — Slack, ntfy, a mail API, anything that takes a POST.

events.description: Which writes notify. Defaults to ["create"] — the form-landed case; update and delete opt in by name.

resources.description: Which resources notify. Absent means all of them.

timeout.description: Milliseconds before an unanswered webhook is abandoned. Default 5000.

auth.description: Sessions are stateless signed cookies. Set SEPTIC_SECRET in production — without it the key is random per boot, so every restart logs everyone out.

seed.description: First admin, inserted only when the users table is empty. A development convenience — change the password before anything is exposed.

media.description: Upload handling for `file` and `image` fields. Without this block the defaults below still apply.

url.description: Public path they are served at.

sizes.description: Widths to resize each image to, alongside the original. Needs `sharp`; without it the upload is still stored, just without variants.

fields.description: Column name to field spec. An `id` column is added for you.

methods.description: Routes to generate. Only what is listed exists.

read.description: Who may GET. Defaults to public.

write.description: Who may POST, PUT and DELETE. Defaults to admin.

fieldAccess.description: Per-field write gate. A field the caller may not write is dropped from the payload rather than refused, so the rest of the write still lands.

indexes.description: Non-unique indexes. A string indexes one column, an array makes a composite.

unique.description: Unique constraints, one entry per constraint.

accessRule.description: "public", a role name, or a list of roles. `admin` passes everything.

oneOf.description: Composite with NULL handling. SQLite counts NULLs as distinct, so two rows with a null column never collide — `coalesce` substitutes a sentinel so they do.

coalesce.description: Column to the value a NULL stands in as.

field.description:
"<type>[ flag]... [ = default]".

types: string, text, slug, email, integer, boolean, datetime, json, file, image, enum(a,b,c), ref:<resource>
flags: required, unique, and on a ref only, ondelete=cascade|setnull|restrict
default: "= value" — "= now" stamps a datetime at insert, "= now!" also re-stamps it on every update.

The parser splits on whitespace, so the `=` needs a space either side and enum values must carry none: enum(a,b,c), never enum(a, b, c). `ondelete` is accepted on a ref only — the foreign key it configures is the one place it is read, so anywhere else it parses and does nothing.

build.description: The poops bridge: DB rows become markup, and forms become partials, before poops compiles the site from the same config file. poops is an optional peer — the markup is written either way, and a missing poops only skips the compile.

resources.description: Resources to emit as markup, keyed by resource name.

forms.description: Resources to emit an HTML form for, keyed by resource name.

into.description: Directory the markup is written to, relative to the config file. Regenerated clean on every run, so a deleted row leaves no orphan file — point it at a directory nothing else owns.

slug.description: Field used as the filename. Falls back to the row id when the field is empty.

body.description: Field used as the document body. Every other field becomes YAML front matter.

layout.description: Added to the front matter as `layout`, for poops to render with.

where.description: Equality filter, keys ANDed — a blog keeps drafts out of the static site while the API still serves them. Values are bound, never interpolated.

buildForm.description: The form is built from the same field DSL that made the table, and posts to that resource's own endpoint. Fields the server owns — `id`, and any `datetime = now` — are left out unless a hint asks for them.

into.description: Directory the form partial is written to, relative to the config file.

success.description: Where a successful submit lands — an HX-Redirect for HTMX, a 303 without JavaScript.

hints.description: Per-field presentation, keyed by field name. Everything here is optional — the field spec already decides the input type.

help.description: Hint text under the control, wired to it with aria-describedby.

widget.description: Overrides the control the field type would pick — text and json give a textarea, enum and ref a select, boolean a checkbox, file and image a file input, everything else an input.

include.description: Ask for a field the form would otherwise own — a `datetime = now`, say.

exclude.description: Leave the field out of the form — a default the server applies, like `boolean = false` on a create form, needs no widget.

optionLabel.description: For a `ref:` select, the referenced table's column to show. Falls back to whichever of name, title or slug that table has, then to its id.
